readback: On every 5th purchase (5th, 10th, 15th, and so on), the member gets the privilege "2 Hours of Yoga Session".
assumptions: 'Purchase' is mapped to activity type PURCHASE (Shopping).
'Every 5th' repeats: the 5th, 10th, 15th and later purchases each earn the reward.
Purchases count with no minimum amount, location or product filter.
No start or end date was given, so the offer has no date limits.
No limit on how many times a member can earn it.
